key: H-hey, can't you see we're trying to have some alone time here?
en: H-hey, can't you see we're trying to have some alone time here?
ja: ちょ、ちょっと、二人きりの時間を邪魔しないでよ。

key: Aahh?! Why are you watching? This is embarrassing...
en: Aahh?! Why are you watching? This is embarrassing...
ja: ああっ!? なんで見てるの? 恥ずかしいじゃない……
でも、なんだかドキドキもするけど……

key: I g-guess you can stay... if you really want... creep.
en: I g-guess you can stay... if you really want... creep.
ja: い、いてもいいけど……そんなに見たいなら……変態。

key: In order to make up for the Aqua Gang's past transgressions, I'll do everything I can to make this garden great!
en: In order to make up for the Aqua Gang's past transgressions, I'll do everything I can to make this garden great!
ja: アクアギャングの過去の過ちを償うために、この庭を素晴らしい場所にするためなら何でもするよ!

key: Everyone in the community came together to patch up old alleys and make a place we could be proud of.
en: Everyone in the community came together to patch up old alleys and make a place we could be proud of.
ja: みんなが力を合わせて古い路地を直して、誇れる場所を作ったんだ。

key: I'd say we've done a pretty good job. How about you?
en: I'd say we've done a pretty good job. How about you?
ja: なかなかいい出来だと思うけど、どう思う?
